column1: # INV-T-6443. Rows for INV-REQ-883 and INV-AC-1915 (read from Keel): the three backticked class names, found as members of $defs.DataClass.

# INV-T-6313. Rows for INV-REQ-709 (read from Keel). INV-REQ-709 and INV-AC-752 name the backticked AWAITING_PRECEDING, ACKNOWLEDGED and QUEUED, which are lifecycle states owned by the submission contract (submission/schemas/lifecycle-states.schema.json), not elements of this contract.

# INV-T-6274. Rows for INV-REQ-714 and INV-REQ-432 (read from Keel). INV-REQ-714 names no backticked identifier; INV-REQ-432 names buyerDisposition, PENDING and REJECTED (rows above), NOT_SUBMITTABLE and BUYER_REJECTED (new rows) and HOLD, which is a severity of the error catalogue and not an element of this contract (the catalogue contract owns it).
# INV-T-6049. Contract identifiers named in the published behavior of INV-REQ-547, 327, 430, 431, 793 and 1192 (read from Keel), plus INV-REQ-428 for the receipt fields.

# INV-T-6626. Rows for INV-REQ-558 (read from Keel). Its backticked `NETTED_INTO_REVISION` already has rows above; the lifecycle states and `ACKNOWLEDGED` named by INV-REQ-559 belong to the submission contract, and `CREDIT_NOTE`, `SUBMITTABLE`, `NOT_SUBMITTABLE` and `PRE_OBLIGATION` are not named by this task's requirements.
# INV-T-6645. Rows for INV-REQ-693 (read from Keel). Its backticked `SR` is an IRAS category code, seed content, not an identifier of this contract.

# INV-T-6995. Rows for INV-REQ-415, 408, 373, 319, 406 and INV-REQ-411 (read from Keel). networkIssuance, networkReceipt, issuedDocUuid, apMessageId, handoffAt and customizationId already have rows above. NETWORK_ISSUED is a lifecycle state of the submission contract (submission/schemas/lifecycle-states.schema.json); submission-svc, canonical-svc and payload-svc are services; integration.engineer is a role; TX and SR are IRAS category codes (seed content): none is an element of this contract.

# INV-T-6937. Rows for INV-REQ-67, INV-REQ-68, INV-AC-195 and INV-AC-2269 (read from Keel). Backticked names that are not rows of this file: `canonical-svc`, `submission-svc`, `tenancy-svc` (services), `entity.admin`, `tax.approver`, `tenant.admin` (roles), `recordElection` (tenancy contract), `dueDate`, `confirmFiling`, `GstReturnRecorded` (submission contract), `PeriodExtended`, `PeriodDueDateChanged` (tenancy events), `PeriodReassigned` (canonical events, already in this contract) and `document.transaction_date`, `submission.due_date` (storage columns, not contract identifiers).
